description: Fork of exp453 (LION beta=(0.9,0.95), 1.4967). qkv axis mirror of exp464: qkv_lut ONLY gets 4x output-scatter sparsity AND 4x tph (64->256); all other LUTs dense. qkv now = 1536 narrow tables (each writes 144/4=36 outputs scattered into the full 144-wide q,k,v_branch output). Param-MATCHED to exp453's dense qkv (21.2M, each out dim ← ~64 tables), but structured as 1536 narrow output-specialized tables vs 384 wide; cost = 4x more qkv lookups/token. Tests whether more narrow specialized tables match/beat fewer wide ones for qkv (as exp464 showed for out_proj). Run in parallel with exp464. Saves checkpoint.
